definitions.gloss: one's own child; biological child; natural child
definitions.explanation: A child who is biologically related to their parent, as opposed to an adopted or step-child. A legal and formal term.

examples.japanese: {実子|じっし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no distinction between biological and adopted children.

examples.japanese: {法律上|ほうりつじょう}、{実子|じっし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{相続権|そうぞくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Legally, both biological and adopted children have the same inheritance rights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実子|じっし}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧{可愛|かわい}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He has an adopted child whom he cherishes as if they were his own.

notes:
A formal/legal term for a biological child. In everyday conversation, people would simply say ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (one's own child). {実子|じっし} appears primarily in legal, medical, and formal contexts.

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧ (implementation, carrying out), which has the same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実子|じっし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: biological and adopted children
- {実子|じっし}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧: as if one's own child
- {実子|じっし}⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧: same as a biological child

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child
- ⟦{継子|ままこ}→継子：20695_mamako⟧: stepchild
- {里子|さとご}: foster child
- {実親|じつおや}: biological parent
- ⟦{養親|ようしん}→養親：16814_youshin⟧: adoptive parent
